MERGE INTO TBL_POLICY ( POLICY_SOURCE, POLICY_EXTERNAL_ID, POLICY_NAME, POLICY_DESCRIPTION, POLICY_KEYWORDS, POLICY_LARGE_CATEGORY, POLICY_MEDIUM_CATEGORY, POLICY_SUPPORT_CONTENT, POLICY_ORGANIZATION_NAME, POLICY_APPLICATION_METHOD, POLICY_APPLICATION_URL, POLICY_SUBMISSION_DOCUMENTS, POLICY_REFERENCE_URL,
POLICY_MIN_AGE, POLICY_MAX_AGE, POLICY_SCHOOL_CODES, POLICY_JOB_CODES, POLICY_MARRIAGE_STATUS_CODES,
POLICY_INCOME_CONDITION_CODE, POLICY_INCOME_MIN_AMOUNT, POLICY_INCOME_MAX_AMOUNT, POLICY_INCOME_ETC_CONDITION,
POLICY_MAJOR_CODES, POLICY_SPECIAL_TARGET_CODES, POLICY_REGION_CODES, POLICY_ADDITIONAL_CONDITION, POLICY_PARTICIPATION_RESTRICTION,
POLICY_SCREENING_METHOD, POLICY_SUPPORT_SCALE, POLICY_ARRIVAL_ORDER_YN, POLICY_SCALE_LIMIT_YN,
POLICY_APPLY_PERIOD_CODE, POLICY_APPLY_START_DATE, POLICY_APPLY_END_DATE,
POLICY_BUSINESS_START_DATE, POLICY_BUSINESS_END_DATE, POLICY_BUSINESS_PERIOD_ETC, POLICY_ETC_NOTE,
POLICY_STATUS, POLICY_UPDATED_AT ) KEY ( POLICY_SOURCE, POLICY_EXTERNAL_ID ) VALUES ( #{policySource}, #{policyExternalId}, #{policyName}, #{policyDescription}, #{policyKeywords}, #{policyLargeCategory}, #{policyMediumCategory}, #{policySupportContent}, #{policyOrganizationName}, #{policyApplicationMethod}, #{policyApplicationUrl}, #{policySubmissionDocuments}, #{policyReferenceUrl},
#{policyMinAge}, #{policyMaxAge}, #{policySchoolCodes}, #{policyJobCodes}, #{policyMarriageStatusCodes},
#{policyIncomeConditionCode}, #{policyIncomeMinAmount}, #{policyIncomeMaxAmount}, #{policyIncomeEtcCondition},
#{policyMajorCodes}, #{policySpecialTargetCodes}, #{policyRegionCodes}, #{policyAdditionalCondition}, #{policyParticipationRestriction},
#{policyScreeningMethod}, #{policySupportScale}, #{policyArrivalOrderYn}, #{policyScaleLimitYn},
#{policyApplyPeriodCode}, #{policyApplyStartDate}, #{policyApplyEndDate},
#{policyBusinessStartDate}, #{policyBusinessEndDate}, #{policyBusinessPeriodEtc}, #{policyEtcNote},
#{policyStatus}, #{policyUpdatedAt} )
mapper.sql:
POLICY_ID, POLICY_SOURCE, POLICY_EXTERNAL_ID, POLICY_NAME, POLICY_DESCRIPTION, POLICY_KEYWORDS, POLICY_LARGE_CATEGORY, POLICY_MEDIUM_CATEGORY, POLICY_SUPPORT_CONTENT, POLICY_ORGANIZATION_NAME, POLICY_APPLICATION_METHOD, POLICY_APPLICATION_URL, POLICY_SUBMISSION_DOCUMENTS, POLICY_REFERENCE_URL,

POLICY_MAJOR_CODES, POLICY_SPECIAL_TARGET_CODES,

POLICY_APPLY_PERIOD_CODE, POLICY_APPLY_START_DATE, POLICY_APPLY_END_DATE,
POLICY_BUSINESS_START_DATE, POLICY_BUSINESS_END_DATE, POLICY_BUSINESS_PERIOD_ETC, POLICY_ETC_NOTE,
POLICY_STATUS, POLICY_CREATED_AT, POLICY_UPDATED_AT
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_POLICY WHERE POLICY_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (POLICY_APPLY_PERIOD_CODE IS NULL OR POLICY_APPLY_PERIOD_CODE <> '0057003') AND (POLICY_APPLY_END_DATE IS NULL OR POLICY_APPLY_END_DATE >= CURRENT_DATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_POLICY SET POLICY_STATUS = 'INACTIVE' WHERE POLICY_SOURCE = 'YOUTH_CENTER' AND POLICY_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (POLICY_UPDATED_AT IS NULL OR POLICY_UPDATED_AT < #{syncStartedAt})
mapper.sql:
WHERE POLICY_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
AND (POLICY_APPLY_PERIOD_CODE IS NULL OR POLICY_APPLY_PERIOD_CODE <> '0057003') AND (POLICY_APPLY_END_DATE IS NULL OR POLICY_APPLY_END_DATE >= CURRENT_DATE)
AND POLICY_LARGE_CATEGORY LIKE CONCAT('%', #{category}, '%')
AND (POLICY_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR POLICY_KEYWORDS LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR POLICY_DESCRIPTION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND (POLICY_REGION_CODES IS NULL OR POLICY_REGION_CODES = ''
OR CONCAT(',', REPLACE(POLICY_REGION_CODES, ' ', '')) LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{sidoCode}, '%')
)
CASE WHEN POLICY_APPLY_PERIOD_CODE = '0057003' THEN 1 WHEN POLICY_APPLY_END_DATE < CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM TBL_POLICY
ORDER BY
CASE WHEN POLICY_APPLY_PERIOD_CODE = '0057003' THEN 2 WHEN POLICY_APPLY_END_DATE < CURRENT_DATE THEN 2 WHEN POLICY_APPLY_END_DATE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, POLICY_APPLY_END_DATE ASC, POLICY_ID DESC
, POLICY_APPLY_START_DATE IS NULL, POLICY_APPLY_START_DATE DESC, POLICY_ID DESC
, POLICY_ID DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT FROM TBL_POLICY WHERE POLICY_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (POLICY_APPLY_PERIOD_CODE IS NULL OR POLICY_APPLY_PERIOD_CODE <> '0057003') AND POLICY_APPLY_END_DATE BETWEEN #{today} AND #{until} ORDER BY POLICY_APPLY_END_DATE ASC, POLICY_ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM TBL_POLICY WHERE POLICY_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (POLICY_APPLY_PERIOD_CODE IS NULL OR POLICY_APPLY_PERIOD_CODE <> '0057003') AND POLICY_APPLY_START_DATE BETWEEN #{from} AND #{today} AND (POLICY_APPLY_END_DATE IS NULL OR POLICY_APPLY_END_DATE >= #{today}) ORDER BY POLICY_APPLY_START_DATE DESC, POLICY_ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT POLICY_ID, POLICY_SUBMISSION_DOCUMENTS, POLICY_DOCUMENT_SOURCE_HASH FROM TBL_POLICY WHERE POLICY_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (POLICY_APPLY_PERIOD_CODE IS NULL OR POLICY_APPLY_PERIOD_CODE <> '0057003') AND (POLICY_APPLY_END_DATE IS NULL OR POLICY_APPLY_END_DATE >= CURRENT_DATE) AND POLICY_SUBMISSION_DOCUMENTS IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(POLICY_SUBMISSION_DOCUMENTS) <> '' ORDER BY POLICY_ID
